_comment: A worked example for make-proposal.py: a made-up conference, so nothing here is a real lead's name or price. Copy it into the lead's own project folder (projects/<id>/proposals/, which stays local) and change the words. Every date on the calendar comes from event.start -- `days_before`, `days_after`, `event` -- or is named outright; move the event and --plan shows the whole calendar moved. Pictures (cover.images, ready.items[].image) are paths beside the spec; this example has none, so the cards show an empty panel. `out` is relative to the spec; here it points into the repo's temp/.
title: A video campaign for DevDays 2027

cover.headline: A video campaign for DevDays 2027
cover.sub: Six weeks to June 10-11 in Amsterdam. Twelve videos in your look, each tied to a date you already have.
